requiredPatternComponents.reason: The reference shows a slate-blue sleeveless crew-neck dress with a fitted waist and A-line knee-length hem. This diagnostic uses a full front panel and two back panels because the back center seam is visible; closure, ease, seam allowance, lining, scale, and fit remain unverified.

researchTrial.method: Use the four directly observed generated views plus a read-only target-avatar profile report to draft a hash-bound 2D shell candidate and named stitch graph; validate with pinned GarmentCode and OpenSew before any 3D stage.
researchTrial.review: The concept supports silhouette and visible detail observations. The referenced avatar report measures body sections only; it does not establish garment ease, seam allowance, sewn assembly, avatar fit, shape-key behavior, or cloth motion.

releaseBoundary: WORKING concept only. Keep visualAppearanceReview PENDING until a candidate 2D pattern is directly reviewed and hash-bound. Do not initialize or generate product 3D before that gate passes.

clothSimulation.reason: The two lower hem vents may expose or deform against the avatar during crouching, sitting, and walking.

shapeKeyPostprocess.reason: No garment mesh or transferred shape keys exist.

bodyProfileEvidence.evidenceBoundary: Neutral and repository-defined Large body cross-sections only; not garment measurements, ease, fit acceptance, or approved size coverage.

waistAppliqueDraft.placement: Eight motifs on the front shell and eight across the two back shell halves; shell remains opaque behind all patches.
waistAppliqueDraft.basis: Relative visual proportion measured against the four-view private concept and provisional shell coordinates; not body-derived ease or an approved garment specification; the provisional center and 30 mm vertical width are recorded with a knee-hem-to-Spine.head arithmetic match, but the avatar hem anchor and dimensions are not visually approved.
waistAppliqueDraft.referenceLinework: The reference reads as interlaced outlined diamonds; this revision uses individual rhombus patches and does not yet model the complete interlaced surface linework.

verticalRegistrationCandidate.method: Assume the knee-length hem is placed at the avatar Knee landmark, then add the flat-pattern waistline height above that anchor.
verticalRegistrationCandidate.assumption: The 2D hem origin maps to the avatar Knee landmark; this anchor is suggested by the knee-length reference and is not confirmed by a garment-on-avatar view.

hemVentDraft.basis: Draft dimensions are image-proportion estimates mapped to provisional shell coordinates. They are not approved garment measurements, ease, or fit targets.
hemVentDraft.evidenceBoundary: Planar notches and matching seam edges only; no sewn 3D assembly, binding, opacity-in-motion, fit, or avatar clearance was evaluated.

waistFitAudit.measurementBoundary: The waist seam maps to the avatar Spine.head plane only when the 2D hem origin is assumed at Knee; this is a candidate landmark arithmetic match, not hem placement, positive ease, fit, or shape-key deformation evidence.
